proposed.text: What is the best source-safe role of Part 1: General in a specification section?

options.text: To establish the section framework, references, submittals, quality assurance, and administrative/procedural requirements.
To list only the physical products and manufactured units supplied for the work.
To describe only the installation sequence and field application steps.
To provide the complete project budget and financing plan.

rationale.correct: Part 1: General contains the general and administrative/procedural requirements for the section, including the framework for references, submittals, and quality assurance.
rationale.takeaway: Part 1 governs how the section is controlled before products and execution are detailed.
rationale.b: Incorrect within the Batch 158 source boundary. Recheck the MasterFormat division, SectionFormat part, or project-standard coordination rule.
rationale.c: Incorrect within the Batch 158 source boundary. This option mixes framework, product, or execution requirements.
rationale.d: Incorrect within the Batch 158 source boundary. Do not import unsupported standards or defer required criteria.
rationale.source_boundary: Batch 158 supports MasterFormat structure, visible public CSI division titles, and SectionFormat organization only.
